title: Key Vault
description: Key Vault using Azure RBAC (no access policies), with soft delete and purge protection, closed to the internet by default, and an optional private endpoint.
security_defaults: Azure RBAC authorization (no legacy access policies)
Purge protection on, soft delete 90 days
Public network access off; firewall default action Deny

purge_protection_enabled.description: Prevent permanent deletion during the retention period. Cannot be turned off once on.

soft_delete_retention_days.description: Days a deleted vault or secret can be recovered. Cannot be changed later.

public_network_access_enabled.description: Allow access from the internet (through the IP firewall).

allowed_ip_ranges.description: Public IPs / CIDR ranges allowed when public access is on.

private_endpoint_subnet_id.description: Subnet for a private endpoint to the vault.

private_dns_zone_id.description: privatelink.vaultcore.azure.net zone to register the private endpoint in.

notes: Nobody has data access after creation. Grant roles such as Key Vault Secrets Officer with Azure RBAC; the agent's identity cannot assign roles.
Because of purge protection, a destroyed vault stays recoverable (and its name reserved) for the retention period.
